questions.question: You get a secret mission with a very short deadline. How do you begin?

options.text: Build a cover story, a new name and a new look
Follow the checklist, one step at a time
Rope in a friend and make it a team effort
Improvise and trust my luck

questions.question: A new school year starts and you know nobody. You:

options.text: Walk up to the first person and declare us best friends
Size up the room and find the person worth impressing
Act older and calmer than you actually feel
Take the seat by the window and watch quietly

questions.question: It is dinner time. What is your place in the kitchen?

options.text: Head chef, with a timer and measured quantities
Brave but hopeless, and the takeaway menu is ready
Setting the table and checking everyone has enough
Waiting loyally by the table, hoping for scraps

questions.question: Someone promises to be proud of you if you do one thing. Which one?

options.text: Come first in the hardest class
Build a clever gadget for the house
Make the whole table laugh at dinner
Quietly fix a problem nobody had noticed

questions.question: You are carrying a secret you must not share. How does it go?

options.text: I smile, nod and change the subject smoothly
I keep it, but I get clumsy and jumpy about it
I tell my best friend and swear them to silence
I carry it alone, even when it weighs on me

questions.question: Your best friend is in trouble. What do you do?

options.text: Turn up before they have finished asking
Bring a plan, a map and a spare gadget
Get side-tracked by a snack, then arrive eventually
Tell them straight where they went wrong, then help

questions.question: A free afternoon in the city. Where do you end up?

options.text: In a workshop, tinkering with something full of wires
In a cafe, talking through everyone's problems
In the park with a dog, chasing every smell
In a library, quietly beating my own record

questions.question: How would you like people to describe you?

options.text: Reliable, always where I said I would be
Impressive, someone whose name sticks
Sweet, the one people want to feed
Mysterious, never quite figured out

profile: You take on a new face and a new name whenever a situation calls for one.
You stay practical and unruffled when a plan is on the line, and keep your softer side for family.
You hold a respectable day job, and nobody around you guesses what else you do.
You are innocent about how the world works, and quick on your feet anyway.
You pick up on what other people are thinking before they say a word.
You are soft-spoken, formal and thoughtful toward everyone you meet.
You work a steady office job by day and keep a sharper side of yourself out of sight.
You are a little absent-minded, and the kitchen is where it shows most.
You are loyal without conditions, and your family always knows it.
You are easily distracted, yet sharper and stronger than anyone gives you credit for.
You are diligent in class, and History is where you shine.
You work hard to be noticed by someone whose approval matters to you.
You often try to act more grown up than your age.
You look up to people who are strong.
You do your job to an exemplary standard.
You are a bit too attached to your sibling, and everyone knows it.
You run a shop by day and tinker with inventions in your free time.
You often end up looking after the kids and pets around you.
You are hopeless in romance, whatever your talents elsewhere.
